_说明: B-roll 提示词增强：image 用于首帧构图（Flux），motion 用于运镜（图生视频）。kind 由镜头描述里的关键词判断，判断不出就用 default。
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, subtitles, distorted hands, extra fingers, low quality, blurry, jitter

macro.image: extreme close-up macro shot, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, crisp detail
macro.motion: very slow push-in, subtle focus breathing, slow motion

hands.image: close-up of hands, natural window light, shallow depth of field
hands.motion: gentle handheld drift, natural hand movement, slow motion

product.image: clean product shot, studio lighting, minimal background
product.motion: slow orbit around the subject, smooth dolly

city.image: cinematic wide shot, city lights, atmospheric haze
city.motion: slow aerial glide forward, parallax, time-lapse feel

nature.image: cinematic nature landscape, golden hour light
nature.motion: slow pan across the scene, gentle wind movement

workspace.image: modern workspace, warm natural light, cinematic composition

people.image: candid documentary shot, natural expressions, cinematic light

abstract.image: abstract light forms, dark background, volumetric glow
abstract.motion: flowing particles, slow swirling motion, seamless loop feel

default.image: cinematic shot, natural light, shallow depth of field, high detail
default.motion: slow cinematic push-in, subtle parallax, smooth motion
